d: Bihar ke mokama men anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ke dauran aayojit ghurdaur men bhari bhir umar pari. halat aise bane ki log mukabla dekhne ke lie apni jan tak jokhim men dalkar 33 hajar volt ke haeetenshan bijli tavar par charh gae. bhir ki sankhya ko dekhte hue anant sinh ne ghurdaur bich men hi rukva di. ab iska phainal raund kal hoga.
